name: Joker X Love

features.name: Multiplier machine
features.description: A three-reel machine reveals a 5x–999x multiplier.

review:
Joker X Love is a romantic twist on the 3x3 fruit classic, with five paylines and a big-multiplier bonus. Three Joker X Love symbols on reels 1, 2 and 3 trigger it.

In the bonus, a three-reel machine spins to reveal a multiplier between 5x and 999x, which is applied to your bet. You can also buy the bonus for 80x the bet where permitted. BGaming rates it very high volatility with a 1,059x maximum and a 96.23% RTP. It shares its maths with Wild Cash, so bought bonuses frequently return less than their cost.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
